capabilities: Look up English words in the WordNet database with autocomplete suggestions
Insert a selected word or definition into the current document
Open the dictionary from the command palette or the ribbon button
Show definitions in a notification window when in preview mode
extras: Documentation is hosted externally; the README mostly points there and promotes the author's other products (JournalCraft, Cornell Notes Learning Vault).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary, so looking up word definitions while writing requires leaving the app.

relations.evidence: WordNet is a large lexical database of English terms developed by Princeton University

summary: Dictionary lookup plugin that searches the WordNet lexical database and inserts definitions into the current note.
